title: Measures of Dispersion
instructions: Answer all questions. For fill‑in‑the‑blank and short‑answer, use one word, letter, or number only.

questions.prompt: Which measure of dispersion is the difference between the maximum and minimum values?
questions.feedbackIfWrong: The range is the difference between the highest and lowest values.

questions.prompt: Standard deviation measures the average distance of data points from the ___.

options: Correct for bias in estimating the population standard deviation
questions.feedbackIfWrong: Dividing by (n – 1) provides an unbiased estimate of the population standard deviation.
questions.prompt: For a sample standard deviation, we divide by (n – 1) instead of n to:
In the empirical rule, about ___% of data lie within two standard deviations of the mean for a normal distribution.

options: Measure the spread of a single dataset
Compare variability between datasets with different means or units
questions.feedbackIfWrong: CV standardizes variability, allowing comparison across different datasets.
